luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local nds = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "networkeddatastore")
check(nds ~= nil, "wrap nds")
if nds.isRegistered() then nds.unregister() end
local name = "wt-" .. tostring(util.now())
check(nds.register(name), "register")
check(nds.getStoreName() == name, "store name")
check(nds.setAccessLevel("public") ~= false and nds.getAccessLevel() == "public", "access level")
nds.set("k", "v1")

local net = peripheral.wrapAt(at(0, 1, 0), "networkmodule").getNet()
local remote = net.getDataStore(name)
check(remote ~= nil, "net.getDataStore")
check(remote.getValue("k") == "v1", "remote read")
remote.set("k", "v2")
check(nds.getValue("k") == "v2", "remote write")
check(net.getDataStore("wt-missing-" .. name) == nil, "unknown name is nil")
check(nds.unregister() and not nds.isRegistered(), "unregister")
print("PASS networked_datastore")
